class: Synchronous telemetry is inserted ahead of a required user-visible startup action
symptom: The full suite's existing foreground-order regression failed after page-opening telemetry was added between navigation and window activation.
root_cause: Window activation followed synchronous telemetry dispatch, allowing event listeners to delay showing the newly opened application.
why_tests_missed: The telemetry integration was not validated against the existing foreground-order regression; the full-suite run exposed the conflict.
fix: Bring the agent's window forward immediately after opening its page, before delivering page-opening telemetry. Preserve the original regression assertion.
prevention: Keep observability after required user-visible startup actions and run existing ordering regressions when adding synchronous listeners.
